per_case_viewing.trigger: Recorded reader menu at 2200 ms, then reader mode at 2650 ms.
per_case_viewing.concrete_observation: Four aligned direction cards fit without clipping; RTL is black-selected. The title row includes the book-default RTL hint. Separate crop and wide-page-split rows occupy the reference slots; split is gray and explicitly unavailable. Progress, chapter navigation and the five-item menu remain legible and bounded.
per_case_viewing.intentional_capability_check: Manual-orientation label agrees with orientation_mode=manual and orientation_locked=true. The explicit unavailable split control satisfies the accepted capability bound without implying implemented splitting. Reading direction is rtl and remember_book_direction=true in the frozen state. Native logical dimensions remain unchanged; reference is at factor two.
per_case_viewing.static_verdict: Accepted for this assigned static state with declared capability bounds; no new actionable visual issue observed.
per_case_viewing.behavior_limits: The recipe opens the panel only. It does not exercise direction changes, crop, splitting, stored-default persistence, hit regions, sensor rotation or a physical device. This is a menu-open state, not closed Reader evidence.

per_case_viewing.trigger: Recorded reader menu at 2200 ms, then reader more at 2650 ms.
per_case_viewing.concrete_observation: The anchored More sheet has a clear heading, an off tap-zone switch and a refresh action in two bounded columns. The obsolete footer-choice block is absent; the compact sheet exposes more artwork. Page progress, next/previous chapter controls and the selected More tab are readable without overlap.
per_case_viewing.intentional_capability_check: Footer-choice omission follows the assigned intentional difference and the closed-Reader artwork-only contract. The off tap-zone switch agrees with show_tap_zones=false. Manual orientation agrees with frozen state. Sheet height follows its remaining content; no footer preference or invisible footer-cycle feature is requested.
per_case_viewing.static_verdict: Accepted for this assigned static state with its intentional footer override; no new actionable visual issue observed.
per_case_viewing.behavior_limits: The recipe only opens More; no tap-zone toggle, refresh action, closed-Reader transition, invisible hit target or persistence is exercised. A visible refresh affordance does not qualify e-ink effects or hardware refresh.

per_case_viewing.trigger: Recorded reader menu at 2200 ms, then reader toc at 2650 ms.
per_case_viewing.concrete_observation: Chapter and bookmark tabs sit above two clear three-row columns. Chapter 34 has the current dot, bold title and 12/40 progress; chapter 35 shows downloaded and chapter 33 shows read. Dotted leaders terminate before status text. The 9/15 panel folio and both page controls fit above the separate reader progress area.
per_case_viewing.intentional_capability_check: The six displayed chapter IDs, their statuses and panel_page=9/panel_page_count=15 agree with frozen state for 86 chapters. Different chapter content and the resulting sheet/pagination allocation are data-driven. The manual-orientation label remains truthful. The top list glyph is visibly identifiable.
per_case_viewing.static_verdict: Accepted for this assigned static TOC state; no new actionable visual issue observed.
per_case_viewing.behavior_limits: The recipe does not activate a chapter, bookmark tab, pager, scrubber or list glyph. Read/download labels are fixture-state projections, not proof of network, durable bookmark behavior, physical input or a genuine live-reader lease.

per_case_viewing.trigger: Recorded sources manage action at 650 ms.
per_case_viewing.concrete_observation: The title/actions, installed-source rail and available-source table preserve a clear two-column hierarchy. Seven installed sources and ten available rows fit; update/install buttons remain separate from subtitles. Source B begins its subtitle with a fully readable unavailable status while the longer verification reason is ellipsized; its uninstall button stays within the rail. The 1/13 folio and bottom navigation fit without clipping.
per_case_viewing.intentional_capability_check: Counts 7 installed, 2 updates and 124 available plus page 1/13 match frozen state. Source B has available=false and compact_status begins with the explicit unavailable message. Different provider rows and concise connection subtitles reflect supplied data. No running pairing endpoint or provider authorization is inferred from the add/source controls.
per_case_viewing.static_verdict: Accepted for this assigned static source-manager state; no new actionable visual issue observed.
per_case_viewing.behavior_limits: The recipe opens management only. It does not exercise installation, update, uninstall, language filtering, paging, server connections, phone/computer pairing or human-verification authorization. Offline demo status is not proof of live provider availability.

limitations: Only the four assigned frozen C7 cases were reviewed; no historical pixel conclusion was inherited and no outside-scope closure is asserted.
All hashes are owner declarations. No application, test, build, probe, validator, SQL query, hash command, SSH session, image processing or skill search program was run.

Original references were opened at their assigned paths; the viewing tool displayed landscape references at 1824x1368 and the portrait reference at 1368x1824. Necessary labels and geometry were readable; no crop was required and no pixel-exact measurements are claimed.

Artwork panel borders and speech-balloon lines are page content. UI observations concern the header, menu sheets, folios and navigation. No source-art identity was inferred from capture metadata, and this batch does not adjudicate an independent source-art oracle.
All reader captures have menu=true. They cannot qualify closed-Reader artwork-only output or invisible footer-cycle behavior. The assigned intentional override forbids restoring footer preferences.

Capture metadata declares the desktop backend and physical_hardware_qualified=false. These PNGs do not qualify physical input, framebuffer/evdev rotation, sleep/wake, e-ink effects, performance or a genuine live-reader lease. Mechanical PASS was not treated as visual acceptance.
